items.title: Hidden Body Map in Brain Explains Complex Coordination
items.snippet: How do you effortlessly coordinate your hand, arm, head, and lips to sip soup? Columbia neuroscientists discovered a previously hidden full-body map inside the brain's secondary motor cortex (M2), found within its resting-state neural chatter, that orchestrates complex multi-limb actions.

items.title: Irregular Sleep Schedules Tied to Depression & Loneliness
